item.title: Potholes at bus stop, 13th October
item.description:
I am writing to raise a formal complaint regarding the severely deteriorated condition of the road outside/near my property, particularly the potholes and uneven road surface, which are causing significant concern and disruption to local residents. The road is in a poor state of repair, and the condition of the surface appears to be causing considerable vibrations whenever vehicles pass over it. These vibrations are being felt within our property and have become a serious concern due to the internal cracking that has appeared inside our house. We are extremely concerned that the continued deterioration of the road and the repeated vibrations may be contributing to further damage to our property. This is not simply an issue of inconvenience or road appearance; it raises concerns about the potential impact on the structural condition of our home, the safety of residents, and the possibility of further damage if the problem is not addressed promptly. I would therefore request that the council: 1. Arrange an urgent inspection of the road to assess the potholes, uneven surfaces and overall condition of the carriageway. 2. Investigate the cause and extent of the vibrations being transmitted to nearby properties when vehicles travel along the road. 3. Inspect and assess the reported internal cracking within our property and consider whether the road condition and associated vibrations may be contributing factors. 4. Arrange the necessary repairs and resurfacing works to bring the road into a safe and satisfactory condition, rather than relying solely on temporary patch repairs if more substantial work is required. 5. Provide a written response outlining the findings of the inspection, the action the council intends to take, and the expected timescale for completing the necessary works. I can provide photographs of the road conditions and the internal cracking within our property to support this complaint. I would also appreciate confirmation that this complaint has been formally recorded and that a reference number has been provided for future correspondence. Given the potential for further damage to our property, I ask that this matter be treated seriously and investigated as a matter of urgency. We should not have to continue experiencing significant vibrations inside our home while the road remains in such a poor condition. Please confirm receipt of this complaint and advise what action will be taken.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 238, Brownhill Road, Catford South, Greater London
